dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It looks like there's a path here. Paimon wonders where it'll lead to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well... it doesn't look like we have any other clues, so wanna just try and see where it leads?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Will there be one up there? But how should we get up?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... Paimon doesn't like this place...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just what is this place exactly? It's like a maze...
